facts: |native notes         = Runs by recompiling it with the Godot RE Tools. Perfect, though there are rare/minor stutters introduced by Apples OpenGL translation layer. <ref> Recompile the game with the Godot RE Tools, like explained in the Brotato modding guide: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?l=danish&id=2931079751 . You get the .pck file of Brotato, by downloading the Game via CrossOver/Wine from Steam, or transferring the files over from a Windows PC. Skip the step with the Steam API and just run it as is, then export it in Godot. You can go into the project settings -> Window and change 1080p to 1200p to make it 16:10, but that introduced some visual issues. To fix the background while playing, open the "main.tscn" and lick on "background", then change 1080p to 1200p there as well. </ref> <ref>{{Refdevice

facts:
|native 3d notes = '''Dual-View Rendering'''
Use [https://helixmod.blogspot.com/2021/10/quake-opengl-vulkan-dx9-dx11.html Geo-11 fix] in [https://helixmod.blogspot.com/2017/05/3d-fix-manager.html 3D Fix Manager] for [[Glossary:Native_3D#Side-by-Side_.28SBS.29|SBS]], [[Glossary:Native_3D#Top-and-Bottom_.28TAB.29|TAB]], [[Glossary:Native_3D#Interleaved|Interleaved]] and [[Glossary:Native_3D#Anaglyph|Anaglyph]].
Or [https://helixmod.blogspot.com/2021/10/quake-opengl-vulkan-dx9-dx11.html Geo-11 fix] with [https://github.com/BramTeurlings/3DGameBridgeGUI/releases 3D Game Bridge GUI] for [[Glossary:Native_3D#Eye-Tracked_Lightfield|Eye-Tracked Lightfield]] displays.

|nvidia 3d vision notes = '''Dual-View Rendering'''
Use [https://helixmod.blogspot.com/2021/10/quake-opengl-vulkan-dx9-dx11.html Geo-11 fix] for [[Glossary:Native_3D#Frame_Sequential|Frame Sequential]] or [[Glossary:Native_3D#Interleaved|Row Interleaved]].

|vulkan notes = Default renderer. Can be forced manually by using {{code|+r_rhirenderfamily vulkan}} [[Glossary:Command line arguments|Command line argument]].
D3D11 can be forced manually with the {{code|+r_rhirenderfamily "d3d11" +d3d11_compileShaders 1}} [[Glossary:Command line arguments|Command line argument]]. It will change the renderer setting in the configuration file. It can cause graphical glitches and disables the Steam overlay.
|vsync notes                = May introduce input lag for the Vulkan renderer with Vertical Sync enabled.
